UDOT - Data Fields & Codes

Contains a list of the UDOT data fields used in the crash app, along with their numerical codes, and the text conversion.

Written by Greg Olsen
April 6, 2021
Table of contents

The following is a list of all the UDOT data fields used in the app, their numerical codes, and the text conversion. These Data Fields and Codes are broken into the following tables: Crash, Vehicle, Person, Driver, Large Vehicle, and Non-Motorist.
